document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You stumble and fall as fractured rock gives way beneath you; 
you incur a sprained ankle and lose 1D2 hit points from bruises 
and cuts. Perhaps you should throw away your water and end 
the torment now. The situation seems hopeless. But you resolve 
to struggle until the very end. 
You choose a direction and drink a day’s water ration: for 
North, go to 254; for East, go to 246; for South, go to 283; for 
West, go to 299.
(245, 283)
